methodology: Methods are AST-parsed from ReadSurfaceStore's class body. Caller lists come from a textual `.method_name(` substring scan of every tracked *.py file (git ls-files), split into production files vs test files (test_*.py, *_test.py, /tests/, conftest.py); internal_call_site_count counts call sites inside read_store.py itself, outside the method's own body. This is a heuristic, not a type-resolved call graph: generically named methods (see caller_match_caveat) can pick up unrelated classes' same-named methods, and callback-only references (`key=self.name`, no parens) are undercounted. __init__ uses an explicit `ReadSurfaceStore(...)` construction-site pattern instead of `.__init__(` because the latter matches virtually every class's constructor calls.
